hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: The degree of a vertex in an undirected network is the count of incident edges.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Initialize an array of size n with zeros.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: For each edge (u, v), increment the degree counter for both vertex u and vertex v.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def findVertexDegrees(n: int, edges: list[list[int]]) -> list[int]:
    deg = [0] * n
    for u, v in edges:
        deg[u] += 1
        deg[v] += 1
    return deg
```

complexity.notes: Iterates through edges and outputs the n vertex degrees in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Adjacency matrix allocation is O(n^2), wasteful for sparse graphs.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stores the degree count array of length n.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Tallies incident edges directly in linear time.
